brief: Spread a known annual bill across the months remaining until it is due.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Prepare for a known future bill"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Prepara una cuenta futura conocida"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Prepare uma conta futura conhecida"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Spread a known annual bill across the months remaining until it is due.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Divide the unfunded bill across deposits possible before its due date.
instruction.misconception: Dividing every annual bill by twelve even when fewer deposits remain or some money is already reserved.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: Subtract money already reserved from the bill. Divide the remainder by deposits available before payment is due.
Use the unfunded amount and only the remaining deposits.
Annual frequency does not mean twelve deposits still remain.
A required contribution is not proof that it fits the budget.
A contribution after the deadline cannot fund on-time payment.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.prompt: Bill 120; already reserved 30; three deposits remain.

steps.spokenText: Split the remainder across remaining deposits.

feedback.met: Use the unfunded amount and only the remaining deposits.

help: Subtract the reserve before dividing.

en-US.scene: Known bill: 180; reserved: 60; remaining monthly deposits: 4.
help: Subtract the existing reserve, then divide by remaining deposits.

feedback.met: (180 − 60) ÷ 4 = 30 per deposit.
